import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to be fully loaded
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # List to store post data in order of appearance
    post_data = []
    
    # Get posts from the main area: two articles
    articles = await page.get_by_role('article').all()
    for article in articles:
        # Get the title link from the heading
        heading = article.get_by_role('heading').first
        title_link = heading.get_by_role('link').first
        title = await title_link.text_content()
        url = await title_link.get_attribute('href')
        
        # Find category link: look for a link with 'cat=' in href that is near this article
        # Since the tree shows category links as siblings in the main area, search in the main area
        main = page.get_by_role('main').first
        category = 'Unknown'
        if main:
            # Get all links in the main area
            main_links = await main.get_by_role('link').all()
            for link in main_links:
                href = await link.get_attribute('href')
                if href and 'cat=' in href:
                    # Assign the first found category link; in this tree, it's directly after the post
                    category = await link.text_content()
                    break
        
        post_data.append({'title': title.strip(), 'category': category.strip(), 'url': url})
    
    # Get posts from the complementary section: five links
    complementary = page.get_by_role('complementary').first
    if complementary:
        # Get all links in the complementary section
        comp_links = await complementary.get_by_role('link').all()
        for link in comp_links:
            url = await link.get_attribute('href')
            if url and '?p=' in url:  # Identify post URLs
                title = await link.text_content()
                # Remove the leading icon character if present
                if title.startswith('\uf141'):  # Unicode for the icon
                    title = title[1:].strip()
                # Try to find category from main posts by matching URL
                category = 'Unknown'
                for post in post_data:
                    if post['url'] == url:
                        category = post['category']
                        break
                # If not found, set to 'Unknown'
                post_data.append({'title': title.strip(), 'category': category, 'url': url})
    
    # Remove duplicates based on URL
    unique_posts = []
    seen_urls = set()
    for post in post_data:
        if post['url'] not in seen_urls:
            seen_urls.add(post['url'])
            unique_posts.append(post)
    
    # Determine the third-to-last post
    if len(unique_posts) >= 3:
        third_to_last = unique_posts[-3]
        result = f"{third_to_last['title']}, {third_to_last['category']}"

import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to be fully loaded
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    # List to store post data in order of appearance
    post_data = []

    # Get posts from the main area: two articles
    articles = await page.get_by_role('article').all()
    for article in articles:
        # Get the title link from the heading
        heading = article.get_by_role('heading').first
        title_link = heading.get_by_role('link').first
        title = await title_link.text_content()
        url = await title_link.get_attribute('href')

        # Find category link: look for a link with 'cat=' in href that is near this article
        # Since the tree shows category links as siblings in the main area, search in the main area
        main = page.get_by_role('main').first
        category = 'Unknown'
        if main:
            # Get all links in the main area
            main_links = await main.get_by_role('link').all()
            for link in main_links:
                href = await link.get_attribute('href')
                if href and 'cat=' in href:
                    # Assign the first found category link; in this tree, it's directly after the post
                    category = await link.text_content()
                    break

        post_data.append({'title': title.strip(), 'category': category.strip(), 'url': url})

    # Get posts from the complementary section: five links
    complementary = page.get_by_role('complementary').first
    if complementary:
        # Get all links in the complementary section
        comp_links = await complementary.get_by_role('link').all()
        for link in comp_links:
            url = await link.get_attribute('href')
            if url and '?p=' in url:  # Identify post URLs
                title = await link.text_content()
                # Remove the leading icon character if present
                if title.startswith('\uf141'):  # Unicode for the icon
                    title = title[1:].strip()
                # Try to find category from main posts by matching URL
                category = 'Unknown'
                for post in post_data:
                    if post['url'] == url:
                        category = post['category']
                        break
                # If not found, set to 'Unknown'
                post_data.append({'title': title.strip(), 'category': category, 'url': url})

    # Remove duplicates based on URL
    unique_posts = []
    seen_urls = set()
    for post in post_data:
        if post['url'] not in seen_urls:
            seen_urls.add(post['url'])
            unique_posts.append(post)

    # Determine the third-to-last post
    if len(unique_posts) >= 3:
        third_to_last = unique_posts[-3]
        result = f"{third_to_last['title']}, {third_to_last['category']}"
        print(result)
        return result
    else:
        print("Not enough posts found.")
        return "Not enough posts found."
